routeHint: Settings -> Users & Profiles -> Registration Form. routeHint: Settings -> Users & Profiles -> Registration Form -> Configure on a row that is NOT the General Registration Form. routeHint: Public page. Requires the tenant's Registration Page Layout to be Side Panel (settingForms.registerForm.layoutMode = sidemenu) AND tenant.authImage set, otherwise RegistrationLayout falls back to the abstract AnimatedBackground blob, which is what the previous shot caught. The field list is whatever the General Registration Form holds, so recapture this together with registration-form-builder.
alt: Side panel registration page with a photo on the left and the form on the right showing email, first and last name, phone, date of birth, gender, town, chapter and two custom fields

routeHint: Settings -> Users & Profiles -> Roles & User types. The Permissions column renders one tag per entry in role.permissions (client/src/views/Tenant/Role/List.vue:132); every demo role held an empty array, so the column was blank on all 13 rows. The organisation and chapter roles now carry realistic permissions and the user types correctly carry none. GET /roles is served through the Doctrine result cache, so a role edited with raw SQL keeps its old permissions in the API until you run: docker exec orgo-1-php bin/console cache:pool:clear doctrine.result_cache_pool cache.doctrine.orm.main.result cache.doctrine.orm.readonly.result cache.app. One capture showed three freshly seeded roles with a blank Permissions cell for exactly this reason.
alt: Roles list with Level and Permissions filters, and columns for role, plural name, level tag and attached permissions

routeHint: Settings -> Users & Profiles -> Roles & User types -> click the pencil on a row whose Level tag reads 'User type'. The edit modal must show the level radio group with 'User type' selected, and below it the Not eligible for fee / Parent / Volunteer switches, the two colour pickers, and the URL Slug field with the '/join/[slug]' help text. Scroll inside the modal if needed. Enable Family Members and Enable Volunteer Roles must be on for the Parent and Volunteer switches to render. The pencil is addressed through the row text ('Honorary Member', level tag 'User type'); the old '.button.is-rounded >> nth=2' never opened the modal, so this shot came out byte-identical to roles-list. The selector crops to the slide-in modal.
alt: Role editor with the level radio group set to User type, and the user type controls below it: Not eligible for fee, Parent, font and background colour, and URL Slug
